div.div: مُكْلَنْدٍ Strong, and thick, big, gross, or coarse, as also ↓ مُكْلَنْدِدٌ : (K:) and the ↓ latter, hard: (S, L:) and strong in make, and big: and, the former, accord. to some, strong; applied in a general manner: or a hard and strong camel; (L;) as also the latter. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
